reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Storage version of `policyexceptions.kyverno.io` changes v2beta1 → v2", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Existing PolicyException objects stay stored as v2beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update are needed before a later release removes v2beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all PolicyException objects and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v2beta1.

proposed.statement: The storage version of the policyexceptions.kyverno.io CRD changes from v2beta1 to v2, so existing objects stay stored as v2beta1 until a storage version migration is run and status.storedVersions is updated before v2beta1 is removed.
